source.provenance: Local paxd chain; LayerX inclusion envelope assembled and signed by the recorder under the genesis receipt pin; Comet evidence is collected independently from the committed chain.; Explorer controller regression source: settlement carries the original batch bytes, transaction/result proofs and linked execution/successor commits; consumers must not re-sign or replace these bytes.
source.conversion: committed-ok retains the recorded committed sequencer answer and complete settlement. Comet height/version integers are decimal RPC strings. eth_receipt projects the recorded execution fields to eth_getTransactionReceipt names; it is not an independently captured RPC response. The batch tx and proof are lossless gateway encodings of settlement.sequence_batch_proof (hex bytes and integer proof positions); negative eth_receipt transactionIndex is projected from its signed receipt index. The positive validators object uses the production gateway-decoded representation, which does not transport the optional Comet proposer_priority field; the recorded settlement remains unchanged.

negative_provenance: Active R7/R8 cases retain V4 signed receipt, transaction and result bytes and mutate only the evidence under test. The unrelated header remains the original independently valid synthetic height-1000 recording. Earlier synthetic receipts are retained under legacy_cases/legacy_refusals; their key IDs do not satisfy the current governed SHA256 public-key identity rule.
